nonlinear_venous_law.native_domain_gate: Positive ZPFV does not guarantee positive absolute volume for arbitrary negative pressure. Enforce V>0 and abs(V-V0)<Vmax; retain lower-leg source inconsistency separately.

cardiac_law.clock: IPFM sanode, nominal70beats/min; PR,Tasys,Tvsys = theta118/119/120*sqrt(RRinterval); time6 initially -PR, atrial time1 initially0. All actual callback clocks remain source authority.
cardiac_law.unqualified_implementation_gate: A rational periodic native clock requires independent source-output convergence; do not claim bitwise source IPFM reproduction from nominal period alone.

incidence_check.total_storage_derivative: -t.flow[0]-t.flow[1]-t.flow[2] for consistent storage laws and fixed reflex offsets; these losses are zero in baseline mode.
incidence_check.lower_leg_exception: Raw eqns_ptr V12 violates the derivative identity when Pt12<0; conservation of incidence alone does not prove conservation of inconsistent raw output volumes.

volume_budget.initial_states_owner: original C estimate_ptr + elastance_ptr + eqns_ptr; this mapping does not synthesize initial pressure/volume states

source_inconsistencies.finding: At lower-leg transmural pressure<=0, eqns_ptr reports Vll=0 while derivative uses positive atan compliance; fixvolume_ptr computes signed atan on the same branch. Output V and pressure ODE are not the derivative of the same storage law.
source_inconsistencies.gate: Retain original source output evidence. Select and name any consistent signed-atan extension; raw-output equivalence only within admitted positive-transmural-pressure domain.

source_inconsistencies.finding: No final else: downstream==external, upstream==threshold, and reverse pressure with both vessels above external can retain prior q4. Example upstream1/downstream2/external0 has no assignment.
source_inconsistencies.gate: Strict reproduction must preserve prior q4 where source is partial; stateless max(upstream-max(downstream,external),0)/R is an explicit corrected variant outside the source active branch.

source_inconsistencies.finding: theta138 takes hemo2 upper-body arterial200mL but feeds descending-aorta x5; theta139 takes hemo3 descending-aorta16mL but feeds upper-body x2. Raw source mapping must remain exact.
source_inconsistencies.gate: Separate table-aligned variant may preserve pressure,flow and total volume by fixed paired translation; individual volume, concentration and transit-time claims change.

source_inconsistencies.finding: The announced IVC correction is commented out. Dormant line would modify x12 lower-leg veins rather than IVC x14. Do not use function name as evidence of enforced volume conservation.
actual entry points call initial_ptr and mapping_ptr in initial.c; initialization.c is a different, unused alternative. Use5150mL theta70 from actual initial.c, not legacy5950mL.
Unused theta76=715mL differs from sum of the8 actual arterial ZPFV parameters=772mL. It is not an additional physical volume owner and must not be added to the21 rows.

Simulator comments describe14+3 pressure entries and6 timing entries, but definitions are25 pressure,24flow,21volume,7time. tilt[0] is sensed-pressure offset and tilt[1] volume loss in live equations, opposite older header descriptions.

independent_primary_source.title: Computational Models of Cardiovascular Response to Orthostatic Stress
independent_primary_source.author: Thomas Heldt
independent_primary_source.acquisition_note: Public MIT PDF host certificate expired; bytes retrieved with certificate verification disabled for this one unauthenticated public artifact. Values independently matched indexed MIT PDF search extract and actual C hemo-table owners. Do not imply authenticated transport.
independent_primary_source.evidence_boundary: Source model parameter-table correspondence, not measured subject anatomy or biological calibration.

volume_coordinate_variants.description: Retains literal theta138/139 assignment and eqns_ptr volume output ownership.
Uses hemo2 upper-body and hemo3 descending-thoracic offsets at their named runtime compartments, matching Heldt2004 TableA.1p157. This is a named composition, not unmodified C volume reproduction.
volume_coordinate_variants.invariance: For each affected constant-compliance row, translating V and V0 by the same delta leaves P=Pext+(V-V0)/C and dV/dt unchanged. Opposite deltas preserve total5150mL and4166mL totalZPFV. All source flow equations depend on pressures, not these translated absolute volumes.
noninvariance: dilution concentration for a fixed amount
any later mass distribution or volume-dependent coupling
constraints: Never silently rewrite raw source parameter vector or original C output evidence.
No invented FMA/B3D region ownership or mechanical blood mass.
Any species initialization and mass accounting need explicit independently sourced definitions in the selected coordinates.

parameter_crosscheck.method: restricted source parser versus independent compiled actual initial_ptr+mapping_ptr C export
